does.text: Each queues a player id: Toggle into one set, Disable into another. Both are called from ecl::PickingHelper::OnInputEvent: Toggle on the path of input event 0x122 when a global core flag (gCore+0x58) is set and the picking helper has a character; Disable on other paths of the same handler (one of them input event 0x123).
does.evidence: EoCClient.dll+0x101F100 LEGACY_ToggleSelector and +0x101F0E0 LEGACY_DisableSelector (a set insert at this+0x18 / this+0x48); caller EoCClient.dll+0xF5B190 ecl::PickingHelper::OnInputEvent (the event-id tests against 0x122 and 0x123, the gCore_exref[0x58] test before the Toggle call).
does.check: not checkable live: queuing leaves nothing in the ECS; the outcome is checked on Update.

does.text: For each player queued by Toggle the system takes the player's camera entity: if the camera does not hold ecl::camera::IsInSelectorWhileInactiveComponent and a test on the player passes, the camera is put on the add list; otherwise (it already holds the tag, or the test fails) on the remove list - a toggle. For each player queued by Disable, a camera holding the tag goes on the remove list. Update then adds IsInSelectorWhileInactiveComponent to every camera on the add list and removes it from every camera on the remove list, and empties both queues. The test walks the characters with ecl::ActiveTurnComponent, ecl::character::AssignedComponent, eoc::combat::ParticipantComponent, eoc::ftb::ParticipantComponent and eoc::IsInTurnBasedModeComponent and compares their assigned player with the queued one; its full outcome was not followed.
